tierBanner.title: You moved up from {fromTier} to {toTier}.
tierBanner.subtitle: New perks unlocked. Check the Reps page.

welcome.title: You're in the crew.
welcome.body: Four more short screens. Then you know where everything lives.

today.title: Today's session lives here.
today.body: Open Today and tap “Start session” on today's card. Your first week's weights come from the lifts you entered. After that they follow what you log.

tabs.title: Five tabs carry the whole app.
tabs.body: Today, Train, Food, Mind and Crew sit at the bottom. Messages is top right, and behind the person icon next to it you'll find Me, Reps, HRV and Science.

formCheck.title: Technique gets a check.
formCheck.body: Tap “Record set” inside a session. Record or upload. HQ gives a first pass; Munk signs off within 24 hours.

reps.title: You get rewarded for showing up.
reps.body: +250 Reps per completed session. +100 per week in a program. Trade them for limited drops, custom-embroidered straps, and 1:1 time with Mikael.
